verdict.rationale: Intuit's official OAuth client offers a first-class sandbox/production switch (`environment: 'sandbox'`), so integrations can be built and tested against isolated sandbox company data. The official QuickBooks Online MCP server carries the same split for agents via `QUICKBOOKS_ENVIRONMENT=sandbox` and adds write-safety toggles (`QUICKBOOKS_DISABLE_WRITE`/`UPDATE`) plus tool-category restrictions. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that sandbox testing works as described, and detailed documentation of how sandbox companies are provisioned and seeded with test data.
